author: xNemoII
body:
Dear Avicus staff,

I recently got temp banned on Avicus for combat logging.

First of all i would like to see the evidence. I may have left the game with low hearts, but i did not do it to avoid death. i left as my mum came into the room.

Second, people have told me that i have been picked up by the console a lot but thats because i leave the game with low hearts, and then look for another game to join. I think the console may detect that as combat logging.

Thank you for reading this appeal and please re-consider this infraction

Nemo

title: My appeal

replies.author: lil_greg15
replies.body:
Hello Nemo,

There is no video evidence of you combat logging due to me noticing you leaving the game while being hit from a member of an opposing team on Nexus and since I wouldn't have had time to record since I wasn't intentionally watching you and it was more of just  noticing it  during the match you will be appealed. Though you may have left the match because of a relative entering the room, it is no excuse to leave the game and keep another user from getting a kill and you will be punished again if caught. If you were to leave the match while not being chased you and not combat tagged console wouldn't have reported you for Joining spectators, Melee. 

You will be appealed due to no presentable evidence.

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie :: Senior Moderator.
